result.summary: The page is visually coherent overall. The partially visible category chip and restaurant card at the right edge, and the card cut off at the bottom, are expected scroll/viewport behavior and are not defects. One minor issue remains: the header account control is an empty, very low-contrast circle.

issues.description: The account/profile control in the top-right header renders as a blank, near-white circle with no photo, initials, or icon, so it barely contrasts with the white background and looks unfinished; only the small red badge makes it noticeable.
issues.suggestion: Show a profile photo, initials, or a default person icon inside the circle and darken the circle or its border so the control is clearly visible and recognizable as a button.
